_comment: Single source of truth for ALL retail prices and shipping amounts (bags, India shipping, free-shipping threshold, international shipping). Edit this file, then run `node scripts/apply-pricing.js` and redeploy (npx wrangler deploy). The API/MCP/agent text (functions/) reads this file directly at runtime; the script rewrites the static copies: product page, store pages, shipping policy, Merchant Center feed, llms.txt, openapi.json, .well-known and Learn pages. Run `node scripts/apply-pricing.js --check` to fail on any stray price. Google Business Profile has no API wired up here — update it manually when this changes.
